title: The emit uses `new Date().toISOString()` directly for `ts`, whereas the mirrore…
body: The emit uses `new Date().toISOString()` directly for `ts`, whereas the mirrored sidecar emit sites use an injected `clock()`. Not blocking (the test does not assert on ts and wall-clock is fine for a durable log), but threading a clock would make the timestamp deterministic and consistent with the makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn precedent.
